quotations.old_english: Gif sweordhwíta óðres mannes wǽpn tó feormunge onfó
quotations.latin: Si quelibet arma politori vel emundatori commissa sunt

quotations.old_english: Ic geann mínon swurdhwítan ðæs sceardan málswurdes

source_text: sweord-hwíta, an; m. One who polishes a sword:?-Gif sweordhwíta óðres mannes wǽpn tó feormunge onfó (cf. Si quelibet arma politori vel emundatori commissa sunt, L. H. I. 87, 3; Th. i. 593, 15), L. Alf. pol. 19; Th. i. 74, 8. Ic geann mínon swurdhwítan ðæs sceardan málswurdes, Chart. Th. 561, 22.
